images.caption: The Punch Bowl - Wingletang The punch bowl is one of the notable rock features on Wingletang Down. It consists of an upper rock balanced upon a lower.  The upper one is reputably eroded onto a large bowl, hence the name.  I've never been able to climb it to confirm this and also never been able to get a pleasing photo of its entirety.  So I settled on this detail!

images.caption: Small gorse patch, St Agnes On Wingletang Down.  This part of the Down, sloping down to the East coast of the Island has soil so thin that in patches the lichen growing on the granite below is mixed-in with the tough grasses and other plants.
